blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 MoHUA Approves Operational Guidelines for ₹9,585 Crore 'PARIVARTAN Scheme'. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Accelerates replacement of polluting NCR trucks and buses with BS-VI or electric vehicles.
Outlay & Central Support: ₹9,585 crore total outlay including ₹5,041 crore central budgetary support.
Incentive Package: Motor vehicle tax waivers, 5% interest subvention on vehicle loans, min 8% OEM discount, and Certificate of Deposit (CoD) trading.
Total scheme outlay (₹9,585 crore) vs central budgetary support (₹5,041 crore).
